ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=20$, $AC=9$. The point $M$ is the midpoint of $BC$. The line $AD$ bisects the exterior angle $\angle CAE$ of $\triangle ABC$, intersecting the extended line of $BC$ at point $D$. Through point $M$, draw $MN \\parallel to AD$, intersecting $AB$ at point $N$. What is the length of $AN$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let NA intersect NF at BN, and connect CF, as shown in the diagram.\\
$\because$BM=MC, NF=BN,\\
$\therefore$MN$\parallel$CF,\\
$\because$MN$\parallel$AD,\\
$\therefore$CF$\parallel$AD,\\
Thus, $\angle$AFC=$\angle$EAD, $\angle$ACF=$\angle$DAC,\\
$\because$AD bisects $\angle$CAE,\\
$\therefore \angle$DAC=$\angle$EAD,\\
$\therefore \angle$ACF=$\angle$AFC,\\
$\therefore$AF=AC=9,\\
$\therefore$BF=AB−AF=11,\\
$\because$MN is the midline of $\triangle$BCF,\\
$\therefore$BN=NF=$\frac{11}{2}$,\\
$\therefore$AN=NF+AF=$\boxed{\frac{29}{2}}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, B, M, C, D are on the same horizontal straight line, and from left to right are B, M, C, D in order, so D is on the extension of BC. Point A is above, B, N, A, E are collinear, and N is located on AB. Segment AD connects from A to D on the right side; MN drawn through M is in the same direction as AD, and the diagram shows MN parallel to AD. The problem statement gives AB=20, AC=9, M is the midpoint of BC, and AD bisects the exterior angle CAE of triangle ABC at A. Reasoning: Let BC=x. Because M is the midpoint of BC, BM=x/2. By the exterior angle bisector theorem, AD is the exterior angle bisector and intersects the extension of BC at D, therefore BD/CD=AB/AC=20/9. Also because D is on the outside of C, BD=BC+CD=x+CD. Thus (x+CD)/CD=20/9, solving gives 9x+9CD=20CD, so CD=9x/11, and further BD=x+9x/11=20x/11. In triangle BAD, M is on BD, N is on BA, and MN is parallel to AD, so triangle BMN and triangle BDA are similar. Therefore BN/BA=BM/BD=(x/2)/(20x/11)=11/40. Because BA=20, BN=20*(11/40)=11/2. Thus AN=AB-BN=20-11/2=29/2.
